scope: Linux secret-store race and ownership coverage

after.missingTools: Explicit ownership mode fails collection with a capability error rather than skipping.

environment.source: Current core source and repair script mounted read-only
environment.stores: mkdtemp fixtures only; ownership restored by EXIT traps

ci.behavior: Use root directly or noninteractive sudo for temporary fixture scripts; missing capability fails.

limitations: Local root-container execution verifies the root branch; GitHub-hosted non-root sudo execution is configured but not yet native-verified.
Other local platforms still skip unsupported procfs/ownership behavior without explicit mode.
This does not establish the complete unit suite or full-plan readiness.
